name: Dental Lace Silk Floss Refills
description: Dental Lace silk floss refills. The brand states the floss is 100% silk with a plant-based wax and peppermint essential oil, and states it has been independently tested and is PFAS-free.
features: The refill page says two 30-yard spools of 100% silk, PFAS-free, thinly coated with plant-based wax and flavored with peppermint essential oil.
The brand FAQ says the silk and PLA flosses "have been independently tested and are PFAS-Free." The FAQ does not name the laboratory. This directory has not reviewed a report.
A Dental Lace post dated August 31, 2021 names vegan candelilla wax. The current refill page says plant-based wax. The FAQ says silk can shred on sharp or uneven teeth.

Amazon ASIN B0753F26N2 is a two-spool, 60-yard silk refill. Consumer Reports reported that Dental Lace provided a full ingredient list and confirmed, or claims, that it does not intentionally add PFAS.
labelNote: PFAS-free is the brand's statement, including its statement that the floss was independently tested. The FAQ does not name the lab. This directory has not run its own test.
